thread_text:
ana: Quick heads up: onboarding job for hera-ptq (int8) showed a weird class of structured-output failures on funcalls. ~1.8% of canary requests returned arrays concatenated without commas, e.g. `[1 2 3]` instead of `[1, 2, 3]`.
ravi: hm, that looks like a tokenizer delimiter collapse or an artifact during streaming chunk boundaries. which path? streaming or final payload?
ana: streaming, mostly when responses are large and get chunked across KV-cache flush. attached raw snippet: ```
chunk1: "[1, 2"
chunk2: " 3]"
actual bytes: 5b 31 2c 20 32 1f 20 33 5d
```
claire: note the 0x1F between tokens (unit-sep). that would remove the comma if interpreted as whitespace by some postprocessors.
ravi: interesting. hera-ptq changed token merge rules during quantization mapping; could be inserting US/RS control tokens to mark soft boundaries.
ana: immediate mitigation options: 1) server-side sanitizer that inserts commas where numeric tokens are adjacent without commas if surrounding chars are digits/brackets (risky). 2) client-side stricter JSON grammar that accepts whitespace like 0x1F as whitespace for parsing only. 3) block onboarding until tokenizer map is fixed.
claire: we should avoid heuristic fixes that silently change semantics. if we repair, telemetry MUST tag repaired=true and we should keep original bytes in debug samples. also cap repair rate so we don't hide regressions.
ci-bot: CI: onboarding/hera-ptq-canary 9 failed parse-smoke (1.8% threshold breached).
nana: proposal: hotfix for canary pool only: implement a conservative "soft-whitespace" preprocessor that maps 0x1F/0x1E to a single ASCII space but only inside arrays/objects when a grammar token is expected. emit metric funcall.parse.repaired with labels {model:hera-ptq, pool:canary}.
ravi: +1 for canary-only. add an onboarding gate: tokenizer-diff test that runs tokenized output for a suite of 2k prompts and fails if control-char emission rate > 0.1% at token boundaries.
claire: also add a streaming unit test that replays chunk boundaries including injected 0x1F/0x1E and verifies no structural corruption after parsing. add a regression to prevent silent unwraps.
nana: CI: added patch to map control chars -> space (canary-only) and emit repaired metrics. running tests locally.
ci-bot: CI: patch-nana/soft-whitespace-handle 9 unit_stream_chunked (FAIL) 9 test expected strict-parse to fail but repair path passed; test updated.
claire: test update: assert both strict and repaired outputs and that repaired flag is true. we must record original bytes base64 in debug-sample for 5% of repaired cases.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary hera-ptq rolled back at 1713456860 (auto-rollback).
nana: rollback confirms it's a model-side tokenization change. next: request tokenization table from model team and run a token-by-token diff against the q4 baseline.
ravi: I'll spin up a comparator job: takes 10k prompts, tokenizes with both tables, records positions where control chars emitted, and correlates with funcall parse failures. expected run ~30m.
claire: long term: add an onboarding step in the model registry that rejects models that emit C0/C1 control chars in the middle of JSON tokens for structured-output canaries. treat any such emission as a hard fail unless declared and documented.
ci-bot: CI: patch-nana/soft-whitespace-handle 9 unit_stream_chunked (PASS) on retry-2.
ana: merging hotfix to canary pool with repair+metrics. will not deploy to prod.
ravi: after comparator job completes, post summary here and include token positions and sample counts.
claire: thanks all. filing a short incident note and an onboarding checklist item.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-221 created for hera-ptq struct-output regression.
notes: hera-ptq int8 canary emitted control chars (0x1F/0x1E) causing array commas to be lost during streaming boundaries. canary rollback, canary-only soft-whitespace repair + telemetry, tokenizer diff comparator and onboarding gate planned
